A woman in a blue Dodgers t-shirt and ripped blue jeans is kneeling behind him, gesturing with her hands. The background shows a clean, minimalist kitchen and living area with white walls and warm wood accents. (2) The boy runs playfully across the room, his movements captured by a low-angle handheld camera that follows him. He approaches another person off-camera to give them a hug, then turns back towards the woman kneeling on the floor. (3) The boy performs a 'cheers' gesture, and pink sparkling visual effects with heart-shaped graphics bloom across the screen. He holds the hands of people on both his left and right, forming a circle of interaction. (4) Close-up shots show the boy's focused and happy facial expressions as he interacts with the adults. The camera captures him from various eye-level and slightly high angles. (5) In the final phase, the boy stands still, looks towards the camera, and shakes his head or gestures 'no' when asked for another heart gesture. A circular graphic overlay appears around his head as he walks away, signaling the end of the scene.
